e.body:
**PricingBandits**（CRAN，**2026-09-09 发布**，即本轮核实前两日）实现**在需求曲线未知时的定价实验**。可核实信息：**版本 2.0.0**、**MIT + file LICENSE**、作者 **Ian N. Weaver（作者兼维护者）、Vineet Kumar、Lalit Jain**、DOI `10.32614/CRAN.package.PricingBandits`（CRAN 页注明 **may not be active yet**）、**Depends R ≥ 3.5.0**、Imports `Matrix`、`hash`、`nloptr`、`MASS`、`dplyr`、`TruncatedNormal`、`R.utils`、无需编译、仓库 `github.com/ian-weaver/PricingBandits`。

方法出处（CRAN 页面写明）：**Weaver, Kumar & Jain, "Nonparametric Pricing Bandits Leveraging Informational Externalities to Learn the Demand Curve"**（*Marketing Science*，doi:10.1287/mksc.2022.0247）。方法族含：**UCB（上置信界）**与**Thompson Sampling（TS）**两个基线，**GP-UCB 与 GP-TS**（高斯过程变体），以及**「约束需求随价格弱递减」的单调高斯过程变体**与**异方差噪声扩展**。设计上值得注意的一点：**支付意愿（WTP）分布由用户以「消费者估值向量」完全指定**，因此**任何需求环境都可以被模拟或复现（replay）**。

对 RIAA：保险定价课程几乎全在**成本侧**展开——频率-强度模型、GLM、费用与利润加成；但**一个费率调整到底赚不赚钱，取决于需求侧的价格弹性**，而这恰恰是课程与实习里最少被量化的一环。这个包把定价问题写成**「在未知需求曲线下边学边定价」的探索-利用权衡**，其中**单调性约束**（价格越高需求不增）正好对应经济学上唯一不能违背的定价事实——**没有这个约束的纯 GP 拟合会给出「涨价反而增量」的荒谬需求曲线**。WTP 向量化输入也让它可以直接当**定价策略的基准环境**使用。池内既有条目中，[[insurance-uplift]] 处理的是「该不该给这个客户营销」的因果提升，而**「该定什么价」的在线学习**此前没有专门条目。相关：[[rate-optimiser]]（费率优化）、[[openrater]] 与 [[ratecraft]]（费率引擎）、[[price-contour]]（价格等高线）、[[insurance-pricing-demo]] 与 [[insurance-pricing-tweedie]]（定价演示）、[[fair-pricing-playbook]]（公平定价）、[[insurance-bunching]]（价格聚束）、[[akur8]]（商业定价平台）。

⚠️ **如实标注三点**：**①** 这是**市场营销学方法在 R 中的实现，并非保险专用**——保险场景存在**费率监管（不得随意差异化定价）、逆选择与续保动态**，直接照搬价格实验有合规风险，须自行论证适用性；**②** 本轮只核实到 CRAN 页面与仓库层面，**未运行代码，未复现论文结果**；**③** CRAN 页面自述 DOI **「may not be active yet」**，即 DOI 可能尚未生效。**核实说明**：CRAN 页面 HTTP 200 实测并逐项读取（版本/发布日期/许可证/作者/依赖/方法出处/DOI 状态）；**未运行、未复现**。
e.body_en:
**PricingBandits** (CRAN, **published 2026-09-09**, two days before this check) implements **pricing experiments when the demand curve is unknown**. Verifiable details: **version 2.0.0**, **MIT + file LICENSE**, authors **Ian N. Weaver (author and maintainer), Vineet Kumar and Lalit Jain**, DOI `10.32614/CRAN.package.PricingBandits` (the CRAN page notes it **"may not be active yet"**), **Depends R ≥ 3.5.0**, Imports `Matrix`, `hash`, `nloptr`, `MASS`, `dplyr`, `TruncatedNormal`, `R.utils`, no compilation needed, repository `github.com/ian-weaver/PricingBandits`.

Method provenance (stated on the CRAN page): **Weaver, Kumar & Jain, "Nonparametric Pricing Bandits Leveraging Informational Externalities to Learn the Demand Curve"** (*Marketing Science*, doi:10.1287/mksc.2022.0247). The method family includes **UCB (upper confidence bound)** and **Thompson Sampling (TS)** baselines, **GP-UCB and GP-TS** (Gaussian-process variants), and — notably — **monotonic Gaussian-process variants that constrain demand to be weakly decreasing in price**, plus heterogeneous-noise extensions. One design point worth flagging: the **willingness-to-pay distribution is fully specified by the user as a vector of consumer valuations**, so **any demand environment can be simulated or replayed**.

For RIAA: insurance pricing courses are almost entirely **cost-side** — frequency–severity models, GLMs, expense and profit loadings. But **whether a rate change actually makes money depends on demand-side price elasticity**, which is precisely the link least often quantified in coursework and internships. This package frames pricing as **the exploration–exploitation trade-off of learning while pricing under an unknown demand curve**, and its **monotonicity constraint** (demand does not increase with price) encodes the one pricing fact economics will not let you violate — **without it, an unconstrained GP fit will happily produce the absurd demand curve on which raising price raises volume**. Specifying WTP as a vector also makes it directly usable as **a benchmark environment for pricing strategies**. Among existing entries, [[insurance-uplift]] addresses the causal question of "should this customer be targeted", whereas **online learning of "what price to set"** had no dedicated entry. Related: [[rate-optimiser]] (rate optimisation), [[openrater]] and [[ratecraft]] (rating engines), [[price-contour]] (price contours), [[insurance-pricing-demo]] and [[insurance-pricing-tweedie]] (pricing demos), [[fair-pricing-playbook]] (fair pricing), [[insurance-bunching]] (price bunching), [[akur8]] (commercial pricing platform).

⚠️ **Three honest caveats**: **①** this is **a marketing-science method implemented in R, not an insurance-specific tool** — insurance involves **rate regulation (differentiated pricing is restricted), adverse selection and renewal dynamics**, so copying price experimentation across carries compliance risk and needs its own justification; **②** this check reached the CRAN page and repository level only — **the code was not run and the paper’s results were not reproduced**; **③** the CRAN page itself says the DOI **"may not be active yet"**. **Verification note**: the CRAN page was measured at HTTP 200 and read item by item (version / publication date / licence / authors / dependencies / method citation / DOI status); **nothing was run or reproduced**.
e.body_hk:
**PricingBandits**（CRAN，**2026-09-09 發布**）實現**在需求曲線未知時的定價實驗**。可核實資訊：**版本 2.0.0**、**MIT + file LICENSE**、作者 **Ian N. Weaver、Vineet Kumar、Lalit Jain**、DOI `10.32614/CRAN.package.PricingBandits`（CRAN 頁注明 **may not be active yet**）、**Depends R ≥ 3.5.0**、Imports `Matrix`、`hash`、`nloptr`、`MASS`、`dplyr`、`TruncatedNormal`、`R.utils`、無需編譯。

方法出處：**Weaver, Kumar & Jain, "Nonparametric Pricing Bandits…"**（*Marketing Science*，doi:10.1287/mksc.2022.0247）。方法族含 **UCB**、**Thompson Sampling**、**GP-UCB/GP-TS**，以及**「約束需求隨價格弱遞減」的單調高斯過程變體**與**異方差噪聲擴展**；**支付意願分布由用戶以「消費者估值向量」完全指定**，故**任何需求環境都可被模擬或複現**。

對 RIAA：保險定價課程幾乎全在**成本側**——頻率-強度模型、GLM、費用加成；但**費率調整是否賺錢取決於需求側價格彈性**，這正是最少被量化的一環。這個包把定價寫成**「在未知需求曲線下邊學邊定價」的探索-利用權衡**，其中**單調性約束**正好對應經濟學上不能違背的定價事實——**沒有它，純 GP 擬合會給出「漲價反而增量」的荒謬需求曲線**。池內 [[insurance-uplift]] 處理「該不該營銷這個客戶」，而**「該定什麼價」的在線學習**此前沒有條目。相關：[[rate-optimiser]]、[[openrater]]、[[ratecraft]]、[[price-contour]]、[[insurance-pricing-demo]]、[[insurance-pricing-tweedie]]、[[fair-pricing-playbook]]、[[insurance-bunching]]、[[akur8]]。

⚠️ **如實標注**：**①** 這是**市場營銷學方法在 R 中的實現，並非保險專用**——保險場景有**費率監管、逆選擇與續保動態**，直接照搬有合規風險；**②** 本輪只核實到 CRAN 頁面與倉庫層面，**未運行代碼、未複現論文結果**；**③** CRAN 頁自述 DOI **「may not be active yet」**。**核實說明**：CRAN 頁面 HTTP 200 實測並逐項讀取；**未運行、未複現**。
